description: Bridges - Supplemental is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. The dataset includes: Railroad Bridges, Private Road Bridges, City Bridges, National Park Bridges, JBLM Bridges, Pedestrian Bridges. This feature class does not contain bridges owned or maintained by either the county or state. These feature classes are in a separate feature class. This data should not be considered complete. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are bridges. The table has 11 columns. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
